standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness transfer along a faithfully flat extension: if A to B is faithfully flat, B is Noetherian and B tensor over A for a finite extension A_1 of A is finite over B, then A_1 is finite over A
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: invoked at proof lines 35719-35720 together with the displayed isomorphism, where the author concludes that B over g^t B' is a finite B'-module and hence that B' to B is finite
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the module-theoretic finiteness of B over g^t B' into finiteness of B over B', which is the finiteness assertion of the conclusion.

standard_prerequisites.name: The quotient of a ring by the ideal generated by a nonzerodivisor behaves well under the identification of the two quotients, so that the induced isomorphism of modules may be read modulo f and g
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: used at proof lines 35714-35718, where the composite A/f^tA' -> f^tA/f^nA' -> g^tB/g^nB' -> B/g^tB' is displayed as an isomorphism of A'/f^nA'-modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the explicit isomorphism whose compatibility with the ring structures and with the given isomorphism phi' is checked at the end of the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Bookkeeping of the ideal inclusions f^tA contained in A', f^tA' contained in f^tA and g^tB' contained in N, obtained from A'_f = A_f and from the compatibility of phi' with f and g
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes B' a subring of B under the definition B = g^{-t}N and makes the product N N contained in g^t N, which is what produces the multiplication on B.

core_obligations: Use the finiteness of A over A' together with A'_f = A_f to choose t greater than 0 with f^t A contained in A', and set n_0 = 2t; this is the choice of how deep the truncation has to be for the construction to close (proof lines 35703-35704).

Given n, B', g and phi' as in the statement, define N as the set of b in B' whose class modulo g^n B' lies in the image of f^t A under phi', and set B = g^{-t} N; from f^t A' contained in f^t A and from phi' carrying f to g conclude g^t B' contained in N, hence B' contained in B (proof lines 35705-35709).

Verify that N N is contained in g^t N, using f^t A times f^t A contained in f^t times f^t A and the compatibility of phi' with f and g, and conclude that B carries a multiplication extending the multiplication of B' (proof lines 35710-35713).

Display the isomorphism of A'/f^nA'-modules A/f^tA' -> f^tA/f^nA' -> g^tB/g^nB' -> B/g^tB' given by multiplication by f^t, phi' and multiplication by g^{-t}, and deduce from the finiteness of A/f^tA' over A' that B over g^tB' is a finite B'-module, so that B' to B is a finite extension (proof lines 35714-35720).

Close the proof by handing to the reader the verification that the displayed isomorphism of modules sends fA into gB and induces a ring isomorphism phi : A/fA -> B/gB compatible with phi' (the author adds that it even induces an isomorphism A/f^tA -> B/g^tB, which is not needed); this last sentence is kept verbatim in the counted span (proof lines 35721-35724).
proof_roadmap: From A finite over A' and A'_f = A_f choose t with f^tA contained in A' and set n_0 = 2t (proof lines 35703-35704).

For given data define N inside B' by a congruence condition modulo g^nB' and set B = g^{-t}N, checking B' contained in B and N N contained in g^tN, which gives a ring structure on B extending that of B' (proof lines 35705-35713).
Display the isomorphism A/f^tA' -> B/g^tB' and deduce finiteness of B' to B from finiteness of A/f^tA' over A' (proof lines 35714-35720).
Read the displayed isomorphism modulo f and g to obtain the required ring isomorphism phi : A/fA -> B/gB compatible with phi', as stated in the last sentence of the proof (proof lines 35721-35724).
difficulty_reason: The lemma starts from a finite ring extension A' contained in A with a nonzerodivisor f satisfying A'_f = A_f, and asserts the existence of an integer n_0 such that for every n at least n_0, every isomorphism A'/f^nA' -> B'/g^nB' carrying f to g can be extended to a finite ring extension B' contained in B together with a ring isomorphism A/fA -> B/gB compatible with it (statement lines 35690-35700). The proof is constructive and not a formal consequence of its hypotheses: the first move extracts an exponent t with f^tA contained in A' and then sets n_0 = 2t, after which the module B is manufactured from the congruence condition that defines N and from B = g^{-t}N, and the two inclusions g^tB' contained in N and N N contained in g^tN are what make B a ring extending B' (proof lines 35703-35713). Finiteness is then read off from the displayed isomorphism A/f^tA' -> B/g^tB' and from the finiteness of A/f^tA' over A' (proof lines 35714-35720). The author ends by leaving the final compatibility verification of the displayed isomorphism to the reader, a residual check that is routine and that is preserved verbatim in the counted span; the construction itself, which is the substance of the proof, is fully present.
